input: to Telugu: Q: How is the DFT related to the DTFT? A) The DFT is a sampling of one period of the continuous DTFT B) The DFT does not require periodicity C) The DFT is the inverse of the DTFT D) The DFT represents an infinite-length signal ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: How is the DFT related to the DTFT? A) The DFT is a sampling of one period of the continuous DTFT B) The DFT does not require periodicity C) The DFT is the inverse of the DTFT D) The DFT represents an infinite-length signal ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of using a feature-based approach over document-level sentiment analysis? A) It captures nuanced opinions about specific attributes of an entity. B) It only requires identifying the overall sentiment of the document. C) It completely eliminates the need for machine learning algorithms. D) It reduces the total amount of text that needs to be processed. ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Document-level sentiment analysis కంటే feature-based approach ను వాడటంలో ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? A) ఇది ఒక entity యొక్క నిర్దిష్ట attributes గురించి సూక్ష్మమైన అభిప్రాయాలను గ్రహిస్తుంది. B) దీనికి document యొక్క మొత్తం sentiment ను గుర్తిస్తే చాలు. C) ఇది machine learning algorithms అవసరాన్ని పూర్తిగా తొలగిస్తుంది. D) Process చేయవలసిన మొత్తం text పరిమాణాన్ని ఇది తగ్గిస్తుంది. జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary advantage of using a feature-based approach over document-level sentiment analysis? A) It captures nuanced opinions about specific attributes of an entity. B) It only requires identifying the overall sentiment of the document. C) It completely eliminates the need for machine learning algorithms. D) It reduces the total amount of text that needs to be processed. ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: What is a primary role of First Order Logic in knowledge representation systems? A) To provide hardware architecture B) To optimize database storage C) To provide a formal basis for automated reasoning D) To design user interfaces ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Knowledge representation systems లో First Order Logic యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) Hardware architecture ను అందించడం B) Database storage ను optimize చేయడం C) Automated reasoning కి formal ఆధారాన్ని అందించడం D) User interfaces ను design చేయడం జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: What is a primary role of First Order Logic in knowledge representation systems? A) To provide hardware architecture B) To optimize database storage C) To provide a formal basis for automated reasoning D) To design user interfaces ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: In the context of image compression, what does moving an image into the 'transform domain' achieve? A) It makes the image easier to resize without distortion B) It encrypts the image to protect copyright C) It converts a color image into a black and white image D) It concentrates signal information into fewer, highly compressible coefficients ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Image compression సందర్భంలో, image ను 'transform domain' లోకి తీసుకెళ్ళడం వల్ల ఏమి సాధిస్తాము? A) Distortion లేకుండా image ను resize చేయడం సులభం అవుతుంది B) Copyright రక్షణ కోసం image ను encrypt చేస్తుంది C) Color image ను black and white image గా మారుస్తుంది D) Signal information ను తక్కువ, బాగా compress చేయగల coefficients లో కేంద్రీకరిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: In the context of image compression, what does moving an image into the 'transform domain' achieve? A) It makes the image easier to resize without distortion B) It encrypts the image to protect copyright C) It converts a color image into a black and white image D) It concentrates signal information into fewer, highly compressible coefficients ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: In a three-phase bridge rectifier, what does the 'pulse number of six' specifically refer to? A) The multiplication factor of the input RMS voltage B) The number of voltage peaks in the DC output per AC cycle C) The number of diodes used in the bridge D) The number of AC supply phases utilized ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Three-phase bridge rectifier లో 'pulse number of six' ప్రత్యేకంగా దేనిని సూచిస్తుంది? A) Input RMS voltage యొక్క multiplication factor B) ప్రతి AC cycle కి DC output లోని voltage peaks సంఖ్య C) Bridge లో వాడిన diodes సంఖ్య D) వాడిన AC supply phases సంఖ్య జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: In a three-phase bridge rectifier, what does the 'pulse number of six' specifically refer to? A) The multiplication factor of the input RMS voltage B) The number of voltage peaks in the DC output per AC cycle C) The number of diodes used in the bridge D) The number of AC supply phases utilized ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why does a learning algorithm with very low bias often have high variance? A) Because low bias requires more training data than high variance algorithms. B) Because a flexible algorithm can fit different training sets in very different ways. C) Because the variance is mathematically defined as the inverse of bias. D) Because low bias algorithms are inherently unstable and produce random results. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: చాలా తక్కువ bias ఉన్న learning algorithm కి తరచుగా ఎక్కువ variance ఎందుకు ఉంటుంది? A) ఎందుకంటే low bias కి high variance algorithms కంటే ఎక్కువ training data అవసరం. B) ఎందుకంటే flexible algorithm వేర్వేరు training sets ను చాలా వేర్వేరు విధాలుగా fit చేయగలదు. C) ఎందుకంటే variance ను mathematical గా bias యొక్క inverse గా నిర్వచిస్తారు. D) ఎందుకంటే low bias algorithms సహజంగానే unstable, random results ఇస్తాయి. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why does a learning algorithm with very low bias often have high variance? A) Because low bias requires more training data than high variance algorithms. B) Because a flexible algorithm can fit different training sets in very different ways. C) Because the variance is mathematically defined as the inverse of bias. D) Because low bias algorithms are inherently unstable and produce random results. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: How does the uncertainty principle constrain the design of an STFT? A) It prevents the use of Gaussian windows B) It defines the maximum number of frequency bins possible C) It sets a minimum possible window size for all signals D) It dictates that time and frequency resolutions have a fundamental trade-off ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Uncertainty principle, STFT design ను ఎలా పరిమితం చేస్తుంది? A) ఇది Gaussian windows వాడకాన్ని అడ్డుకుంటుంది B) సాధ్యమైన గరిష్ట frequency bins సంఖ్యను ఇది నిర్వచిస్తుంది C) అన్ని signals కి సాధ్యమైన కనిష్ట window size ను ఇది నిర్ణయిస్తుంది D) Time మరియు frequency resolutions మధ్య ప్రాథమిక trade-off ఉంటుందని ఇది నిర్దేశిస్తుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: How does the uncertainty principle constrain the design of an STFT? A) It prevents the use of Gaussian windows B) It defines the maximum number of frequency bins possible C) It sets a minimum possible window size for all signals D) It dictates that time and frequency resolutions have a fundamental trade-off ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is a pushdown automaton considered more powerful than a finite-state machine? A) It can access input symbols multiple times B) It uses an infinite tape for storage C) It is always deterministic D) It possesses a stack memory to store and retrieve data ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Finite-state machine కంటే pushdown automaton ను ఎందుకు ఎక్కువ శక్తివంతమైనదిగా భావిస్తారు? A) ఇది input symbols ను అనేకసార్లు access చేయగలదు B) ఇది storage కోసం infinite tape ను వాడుతుంది C) ఇది ఎల్లప్పుడూ deterministic D) Data ను store చేయడానికి మరియు తిరిగి పొందడానికి దీనికి stack memory ఉంటుంది జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is a pushdown automaton considered more powerful than a finite-state machine? A) It can access input symbols multiple times B) It uses an infinite tape for storage C) It is always deterministic D) It possesses a stack memory to store and retrieve data ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is the carrier wave essential in standard Amplitude Modulation? A) It converts digital data to analog B) It provides a frequency reference and amplitude reference for the receiver C) It reduces the bandwidth of the message signal D) It is only required for spark gap transmitters ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard Amplitude Modulation లో carrier wave ఎందుకు అవసరం? A) ఇది digital data ను analog గా మారుస్తుంది B) ఇది receiver కి frequency reference మరియు amplitude reference ను అందిస్తుంది C) ఇది message signal యొక్క bandwidth ను తగ్గిస్తుంది D) ఇది కేవలం spark gap transmitters కే అవసరం జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is the carrier wave essential in standard Amplitude Modulation? A) It converts digital data to analog B) It provides a frequency reference and amplitude reference for the receiver C) It reduces the bandwidth of the message signal D) It is only required for spark gap transmitters ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why did Maxwell introduce the concept of displacement current to Ampère's circuital law? A) To allow magnetic fields to create stationary electrostatic charges. B) To account for the frictional resistance of charged particles in vacuum. C) To satisfy the continuity equation and account for time-varying electric fields. D) To prove that magnetic monopoles can exist under high frequency. ANSWER: C
target: ప్రశ్న: Maxwell, Ampère's circuital law కి displacement current అనే భావనను ఎందుకు ప్రవేశపెట్టారు? A) Magnetic fields స్థిరమైన electrostatic charges ను సృష్టించడానికి వీలు కల్పించడానికి. B) Vacuum లో charged particles యొక్క frictional resistance ను పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకోవడానికి. C) Continuity equation ను సంతృప్తిపరచడానికి మరియు time-varying electric fields ను పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకోవడానికి. D) High frequency వద్ద magnetic monopoles ఉండగలవని నిరూపించడానికి. జవాబు: C
target_en: Q: Why did Maxwell introduce the concept of displacement current to Ampère's circuital law? A) To allow magnetic fields to create stationary electrostatic charges. B) To account for the frictional resistance of charged particles in vacuum. C) To satisfy the continuity equation and account for time-varying electric fields. D) To prove that magnetic monopoles can exist under high frequency. ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: Under what condition does an implicit system of equations F(x, y, y') = 0 become a differential algebraic equation (DAE) rather than an explicit ODE system? A) When the boundary conditions are non-homogeneous B) When the Jacobian matrix ∂F/∂y' is singular C) When the independent variable is absent from the system D) When the equation contains no nonlinear terms ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: ఏ షరతు కింద ఒక implicit system of equations F(x, y, y') = 0, explicit ODE system కాకుండా differential algebraic equation (DAE) అవుతుంది? A) Boundary conditions non-homogeneous అయినప్పుడు B) Jacobian matrix ∂F/∂y' singular అయినప్పుడు C) System లో independent variable లేనప్పుడు D) Equation లో nonlinear terms ఏవీ లేనప్పుడు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Under what condition does an implicit system of equations F(x, y, y') = 0 become a differential algebraic equation (DAE) rather than an explicit ODE system? A) When the boundary conditions are non-homogeneous B) When the Jacobian matrix ∂F/∂y' is singular C) When the independent variable is absent from the system D) When the equation contains no nonlinear terms ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary role of backpropagation in deep neural networks? A) To compute gradients and update weights to minimize prediction error B) To optimize the architecture by adding more hidden layers C) To initialize the weights randomly before training begins D) To perform inference on new, unseen data samples ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Deep neural networks లో backpropagation యొక్క ప్రధాన పాత్ర ఏమిటి? A) Prediction error ను తగ్గించడానికి gradients ను లెక్కించి weights ను update చేయడం B) మరిన్ని hidden layers ను జోడించడం ద్వారా architecture ను optimize చేయడం C) Training ప్రారంభానికి ముందు weights ను random గా initialize చేయడం D) కొత్త, ఇంతకు ముందు చూడని data samples పై inference చేయడం జవాబు: A
target_en: Q: What is the primary role of backpropagation in deep neural networks? A) To compute gradients and update weights to minimize prediction error B) To optimize the architecture by adding more hidden layers C) To initialize the weights randomly before training begins D) To perform inference on new, unseen data samples ANSWER: A

input: to Telugu: Q: How does applying negative feedback primarily affect the gain of an op-amp circuit? A) It makes the circuit gain unpredictable B) It reduces the gain and stabilizes it via external components C) It increases the total open-loop gain D) It eliminates the requirement for a power supply ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Negative feedback ను apply చేయడం op-amp circuit యొక్క gain ను ప్రధానంగా ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది? A) ఇది circuit gain ను అనూహ్యంగా మారుస్తుంది B) ఇది gain ను తగ్గించి, external components ద్వారా దానిని stabilize చేస్తుంది C) ఇది మొత్తం open-loop gain ను పెంచుతుంది D) ఇది power supply అవసరాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does applying negative feedback primarily affect the gain of an op-amp circuit? A) It makes the circuit gain unpredictable B) It reduces the gain and stabilizes it via external components C) It increases the total open-loop gain D) It eliminates the requirement for a power supply ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is it challenging to directly compare the error rates of computer systems to human raters in sentiment analysis? A) Computer systems are only tested on a small subset of data. B) Computer systems are programmed to be more accurate than humans. C) Human raters are not allowed to use the same tools as the systems. D) Human raters typically only agree with each other about 80% of the time. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Sentiment analysis లో computer systems యొక్క error rates ను human raters తో నేరుగా పోల్చడం ఎందుకు కష్టం? A) Computer systems ను data యొక్క చిన్న భాగంపై మాత్రమే test చేస్తారు. B) Computer systems మనుషుల కంటే ఎక్కువ accurate గా ఉండేలా program చేయబడ్డాయి. C) Systems వాడే tools నే human raters వాడటానికి అనుమతి లేదు. D) Human raters సాధారణంగా ఒకరితో ఒకరు దాదాపు 80% సమయం మాత్రమే ఏకీభవిస్తారు. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: Why is it challenging to directly compare the error rates of computer systems to human raters in sentiment analysis? A) Computer systems are only tested on a small subset of data. B) Computer systems are programmed to be more accurate than humans. C) Human raters are not allowed to use the same tools as the systems. D) Human raters typically only agree with each other about 80% of the time. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: How does a semiconductor logic gate fundamentally differ from a relay logic gate in its operation? A) A semiconductor gate uses moving parts, while a relay uses solid-state components. B) A semiconductor gate acts as a high-gain voltage amplifier, while a relay creates a continuous metallic path. C) A semiconductor gate consumes more power than a relay. D) A semiconductor gate is larger and slower than a relay. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: పనితీరు పరంగా semiconductor logic gate, relay logic gate నుండి ప్రాథమికంగా ఎలా భిన్నంగా ఉంటుంది? A) Semiconductor gate moving parts ను వాడుతుంది, relay solid-state components ను వాడుతుంది. B) Semiconductor gate ఒక high-gain voltage amplifier లా పనిచేస్తుంది, relay ఒక నిరంతర metallic path ను ఏర్పరుస్తుంది. C) Semiconductor gate relay కంటే ఎక్కువ power ను వినియోగిస్తుంది. D) Semiconductor gate relay కంటే పెద్దది మరియు నెమ్మదిగా ఉంటుంది. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: How does a semiconductor logic gate fundamentally differ from a relay logic gate in its operation? A) A semiconductor gate uses moving parts, while a relay uses solid-state components. B) A semiconductor gate acts as a high-gain voltage amplifier, while a relay creates a continuous metallic path. C) A semiconductor gate consumes more power than a relay. D) A semiconductor gate is larger and slower than a relay. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: In the Routh array method, what does the number of sign changes in the first column indicate? A) The total number of roots of the polynomial. B) The number of roots with positive real parts. C) The number of roots exactly on the imaginary axis. D) The stability of the system's input signal. ANSWER: B

target_en: Q: In the Routh array method, what does the number of sign changes in the first column indicate? A) The total number of roots of the polynomial. B) The number of roots with positive real parts. C) The number of roots exactly on the imaginary axis. D) The stability of the system's input signal. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What situation leads to deterministic noise in a learning problem? A) When the input features are not scaled to the [-1, 1] interval. B) When the target function is too complex for the learning model. C) When the learning model is too simple to capture the true function. D) When the training labels are randomly assigned by a human. ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: Learning problem లో deterministic noise కి ఏ పరిస్థితి దారితీస్తుంది? A) Input features ను [-1, 1] interval కి scale చేయనప్పుడు. B) Learning model కి target function చాలా complex గా ఉన్నప్పుడు. C) నిజమైన function ను గ్రహించడానికి learning model మరీ simple గా ఉన్నప్పుడు. D) Training labels ను మనిషి random గా కేటాయించినప్పుడు. జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: What situation leads to deterministic noise in a learning problem? A) When the input features are not scaled to the [-1, 1] interval. B) When the target function is too complex for the learning model. C) When the learning model is too simple to capture the true function. D) When the training labels are randomly assigned by a human. ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary advantage of Single-sideband modulation compared to standard AM? A) It improves power efficiency and reduces required bandwidth B) It eliminates the need for a carrier frequency C) It requires a simpler receiver design D) It allows for faster data rates ANSWER: A
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard AM తో పోలిస్తే Single-sideband modulation యొక్క ప్రధాన ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి? input: to Telugu: Q: Where on the Poincaré sphere are pure linearly polarized states represented? A) At the north and south poles B) At the exact center of the sphere C) Only at the origin point D) Along the equator of the sphere ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is an AST considered abstract rather than concrete? A) It requires runtime evaluation to resolve B) It excludes nonessential punctuation like semicolons and parentheses C) It stores only lexical tokens without structure D) It is built directly from machine code ANSWER: B
target: ప్రశ్న: AST ను concrete గా కాకుండా abstract గా ఎందుకు భావిస్తారు? A) దీనిని resolve చేయడానికి runtime evaluation అవసరం B) ఇది semicolons మరియు parentheses లాంటి అవసరం లేని punctuation ను వదిలివేస్తుంది C) ఇది structure లేకుండా కేవలం lexical tokens ను మాత్రమే store చేస్తుంది D) దీనిని నేరుగా machine code నుండి నిర్మిస్తారు జవాబు: B
target_en: Q: Why is an AST considered abstract rather than concrete? A) It requires runtime evaluation to resolve B) It excludes nonessential punctuation like semicolons and parentheses C) It stores only lexical tokens without structure D) It is built directly from machine code ANSWER: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the fundamental principle behind a transformer's operation? A) A constant magnetic field induces a constant current. B) A static magnetic field induces a voltage in a primary coil. C) A changing electric field induces a magnetic field. D) A changing magnetic field induces an electromotive force in a secondary coil. ANSWER: D

D) మారుతున్న magnetic field ఒక secondary coil లో electromotive force ను induce చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the fundamental principle behind a transformer's operation? A) A constant magnetic field induces a constant current. B) A static magnetic field induces a voltage in a primary coil. C) A changing electric field induces a magnetic field. D) A changing magnetic field induces an electromotive force in a secondary coil. ANSWER: D

input: to Telugu: Q: Why is artifact management critical before performing HRV analysis? A) It is only required for long-term studies B) It improves the aesthetic quality of the graph C) Even a 2% error can bias HRV calculations D) It changes the fundamental definition of HRV ANSWER: C

target_en: Q: Why is artifact management critical before performing HRV analysis? A) It is only required for long-term studies B) It improves the aesthetic quality of the graph C) Even a 2% error can bias HRV calculations D) It changes the fundamental definition of HRV ANSWER: C

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary responsibility of the MAC sublayer within the data link layer? A) Encrypting data frames B) Controlling device access to the transmission medium C) Establishing end-to-end connections D) Routing packets between different networks ANSWER: B

B) It describes the entropy increase in natural processes. C) It proves that perpetual motion is impossible. D) It establishes the conservation of energy in closed systems. ANSWER: A

target_en: Q: Why is a window function applied before computing a transform on a finite sequence? A) To convert the signal to the Z-domain B) To mitigate spectral artifacts caused by truncating an infinite signal C) To make the signal periodic D) To increase the sampling frequency ANSWER: B

B) ఎందుకంటే అది అన్ని locks ను చివరి వరకు పట్టి ఉంచుతుంది, కానీ standard 2PL shrinking phase లో read locks ను release చేయడానికి అనుమతిస్తుంది. C) ఎందుకంటే transactions commit అయ్యే ముందే అన్ని locks ను release చేయాలని అది కోరుతుంది. D) ఎందుకంటే అది transactions ను concurrent గా కాకుండా serial గా execute అయ్యేలా బలవంతం చేస్తుంది. జవాబు: B

input: to Telugu: Q: What is the primary trade-off associated with Conservative Two-Phase Locking (C2PL) compared to standard 2PL? A) It increases the probability of deadlocks in exchange for lower overhead. B) It is faster because it allows transactions to acquire locks dynamically. C) It provides better concurrency by allowing more transactions to run in parallel. D) It avoids deadlocks but often holds locks longer than necessary, increasing overhead. ANSWER: D
target: ప్రశ్న: Standard 2PL తో పోలిస్తే Conservative Two-Phase Locking (C2PL) తో ముడిపడిన ప్రధాన trade-off ఏమిటి? A) తక్కువ overhead కి బదులుగా ఇది deadlocks సంభావ్యతను పెంచుతుంది. B) Transactions locks ను dynamic గా acquire చేయడానికి అనుమతించడం వల్ల ఇది వేగంగా ఉంటుంది. C) ఎక్కువ transactions parallel గా run అవ్వడానికి అనుమతించడం ద్వారా ఇది మెరుగైన concurrency ని ఇస్తుంది. D) ఇది deadlocks ను నివారిస్తుంది కానీ తరచుగా locks ను అవసరమైన దానికంటే ఎక్కువ సేపు పట్టి ఉంచుతుంది, దాంతో overhead పెరుగుతుంది. జవాబు: D
target_en: Q: What is the primary trade-off associated with Conservative Two-Phase Locking (C2PL) compared to standard 2PL? A) It increases the probability of deadlocks in exchange for lower overhead. B) It is faster because it allows transactions to acquire locks dynamically. C) It provides better concurrency by allowing more transactions to run in parallel. D) It avoids deadlocks but often holds locks longer than necessary, increasing overhead. ANSWER: D
